items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: it was written by Ralph Burns

ctx.x: Alabama. Well we started playing in the beginning, people just coming into the room, right? [sings] “It was just one of those things,” sounds like a general business band except it was written by Ralph Burns. But we were getting away with it only everything’s in two, right? And the second set comes by and we’re still in two — we take a break, we come back and we’re in two. By now these old politicians and whatever they are, are getting a little juiced and they’re feeling no pain. Then we go to four. Now when we…

Didn’t mess around. I’d like to ask you, because some people who might watch this may not know what are you talking about, in two and in four. And do you have memories of, now I’m thinking of you at Berklee and starting off the year and you’ve got the Dues © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
